use default

power(base: long, exponent: int) -> long is
    let value mut = 1L

    for _ in 0..exponent do
        value = value * base
    od

    return value
si

powers(exponent: int) -> Pipe[long] is
    let base mut = 0L

    do
        yield power(base, exponent)

        base = base + 1L
    od
si

next_power(powers: Pipe[long]) -> long is
    assert powers.move_next() else "the powers never run out"

    return powers.current
si

without(values: Pipe[long], excluded: Pipe[long]) -> Pipe[long] is
    let skipped mut = next_power(excluded)

    for value in values do
        while skipped < value do
            skipped = next_power(excluded)
        od

        if skipped != value then
            yield value
        fi
    od
si

let squares_that_are_not_cubes = without(powers(2), powers(3))
    |> skip(20)
    |> take(10)

write_line(squares_that_are_not_cubes |> join(" "))
